model: RandomForestClassifier (scikit-learn, n_estimators=200, random_state=42) on the 8 raw features, no imputation or scaling; stratified 80/20 train/test split (random_state=42)
notes: Zeros in glucose, blood_pressure, skin_thickness, insulin and bmi were kept as-is (likely missing placeholders). 14 of 185 test rows exactly duplicate training rows; excluding them, test accuracy is 0.90 on the 171 novel rows. 5-fold CV on the training set gave 0.841.
